ns2:course.label: Issues&Careers in Applied Econ
ns2:course.description: Students study contemporary issues and career opportunities associated with various concentrations in the Department of Agricultural and Consumer Economics. An in-depth dialogue with industry professionals helps develop an understanding of the skill sets needed to succeed in each of the different career paths discussed. May not be repeated for credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May not be repeated for credit.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
